verdict.rationale: Medusa documents Order and Fulfillment modules and keeps machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs, which gives an agent a documented programmatic surface for order management. A community user also notes swaps and returns ship out of the box. However, the only webhook evidence is a bare 'Webhook Events' line on the pricing page, with no docs on registering callbacks, and no evidence shows the status, fulfillment and return steps working end to end via API. Missing for 10: documented registrable webhook endpoints and event catalog for order lifecycle events, explicit Admin API docs for status/fulfillment/return transitions, hands-on corroboration of headless lifecycle automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can take an order through its post-purchase lifecycle — status, fulfillment, returns — via documented APIs and webhooks without a human in the admin

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs
Swap Difference - love that you have this out of the box.
